target.learningOutcome: The learner can define @RestController and trace a mapped Java return value through message conversion into an HTTP response body.
prerequisites: Basic HTTP request and response knowledge

claims.statement: @RestController is composed from @Controller and @ResponseBody, so response-body semantics apply to every request-handling method in the class.

Spring MVC delegates a response-body return value to a compatible HttpMessageConverter for the selected media type; JSON is one possible representation rather than a guarantee of the annotation itself.
A String response is normally written by StringHttpMessageConverter, while a DTO may be written by Jackson when JSON conversion is configured and selected.

examples.title: Verify a record response as JSON and a String response as unquoted text

validation.command: Run gold.q1.RestControllerTest with Java 17, Spring Boot 3.3.1, and standalone MockMvc
validation.expected: GET /orders/42 returns HTTP 200 JSON with id 42 and item Keyboard; GET /status returns the raw body ready
